final: WITH c AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_all FROM c), k AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_all), ka AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_kept FROM k) SELECT k.account_id, k.cnt AS order_count, k.cnt - a.avg_all AS above_avg, k.cnt - ka.avg_kept AS above_kept_avg FROM k, a, ka ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
